guards._aboutBlockFloor: The least of a blow a Block lets through, however good the shield and the talents (Robin, 2026-11-03: 25%, was 15%).

worldBoss._aboutLands: Each land's own world boss (Robin, 2026-11-04: one per land; King Goo as the Meadows' world boss was weird, "since he is also the boss at the end"). It comes to the furthest open land that has one; a land with none (the city, the Kingswood, a grown land) never hosts one. The creatures and names are mine, with their land's gate boss's numbers.

_aboutSoftcap: Robin, 2026-11-02: 'softcap exp by zone, so that you need more exp to level up, and so you want to kill higher enemies'. A creature below you pays less by `below` a level, down to `floor`; one above you pays more by `above` a level, up to `aboveMax`; past the top of a land's levels its plain creatures pay `outgrownLand` on top. Gold takes the cut, not the bonus.

dayNight._about: Day and night counted in die rolls (Robin, 2026-11-03: 'a day is 24 rolls, a night is 12 rolls, or whatever is more appropriate'; he chose 20 and 10). At night the wild's creatures are stronger and pay more; bosses stay as they are. Numbers mine.
